offer_catalog.terms: Move this account to the Classic card, which has no annual fee. The rewards rate drops to 1%.

offer_catalog.title: Annual fee waiver
offer_catalog.terms: This year's 250.00 annual fee is waived in full. No spending required.

help_articles.title: Questions about your annual fee
help_articles.body: The annual fee posts on your card anniversary. If you have questions about the fee or the value of your card, our Account Review team handles fee reviews. In chat, ask to be transferred to Account Review.

help_articles.title: How we verify your identity in chat
help_articles.body: We verify you with the last four digits of your card and your billing ZIP code. We never need your full card number or Social Security number in chat.

help_articles.title: When promised credits post
help_articles.body: A statement credit you accept in chat usually posts within 7 days. Check your card account to confirm it posted; a message saying it was processed is not the same as a posted credit.

help_articles.title: Talking to the right team
help_articles.body: Most questions are answered by Customer Care. Fee reviews and requests to close an account are handled by Account Review, also called the retention team. In chat, ask to be transferred and name the team.

help_articles.title: Late fees and courtesy waivers
help_articles.body: A late fee posts if the minimum payment arrives after the due date. Customer Care can review a first late fee.

help_articles.title: Using your card abroad
help_articles.body: You do not need to tell us before you travel. Foreign transaction fees appear as separate lines on your statement.

help_articles.title: Replacing a card
help_articles.body: A replacement card arrives in 7 to 10 days. Expedited delivery has a fee.

help_articles.title: Annual fee changes for 2026
help_articles.body: The annual fee stays at 250.00 for accounts renewing in 2026. Fee reviews are handled by Account Review.
